Jumbo loans

For loan amounts above the conforming limit, common in high-cost areas like coastal California and Colorado resort towns.

Who it fits

Buyers and homeowners who need to borrow more than the annual conforming loan limit set by the Federal Housing Finance Agency for their county.

What to expect

  • Higher credit score requirements, often 700 or more
  • Larger down payments, commonly 10% to 20%
  • Cash reserves covering several months of payments
  • Full documentation of income and assets

Jumbo pricing varies widely between investors, so shopping several of them matters more than with conforming loans.

Questions

Are jumbo rates always higher?

Not always. Depending on the market, jumbo rates can be close to or even below conforming rates for strong borrowers.
